QuestInfo.name: A Request from Corporal Easy
QuestInfo.1: Corporal Easy in Orbis Tower wants you to deliver an item to Master Sergeant Fox. He also asks for #b20 refined #t4000061#s#k.
QuestInfo.2: You brought #b20 refined #t4000061#s#k to Corporal Easy. You should be able to go see Master Sergeant Fox now.

0.0: What? You came all the way to here by #b#p2020003##k's request? I thought I was the only survivor. I knew that nothing can hurt #b#p2020003##k. HAHA!
0.1: It is good to hear that he is alive. So he is working at El Nath huh? Okay... I found #b#t4031049##k and this would be somewhat related to our mission.
0.2: #b#p2020003##k should be waiting for this item. I'll give it to you if you bring me #b20 #t4000061#s#k. Without this, you won't be able to prove that you met me. Keep it safe until you deliver it to #b#p2020003##k!
